Gold Standard · Kuwait

Account deletion

iOS app, Android app, and goldstandardkw.com. Effective date: 19 August 2026.

You can close your Gold Standard login from inside the app or website. Emailing support is optional and is not required to start deletion (Apple App Store guideline 5.1.1(v)).

1. How to delete

In the Gold Standard app: More → Delete account. Sign in, tick the five-year retention notice, then tap Delete my account.

On the website: goldstandardkw.com/data-deletion (same control after sign-in).

The account is closed immediately. You are signed out and cannot log in again.

2. What is removed immediately

  • Ability to sign in (password and Google/Apple login blocked)
  • Shopping cart and saved addresses
  • Price alerts and push notification tokens
  • Profile photo and pending email/phone change requests

3. What Kuwait law requires us to keep (5 years)

Under Law No. 106 of 2013 (AML/CFT) and Central Bank of Kuwait AML instructions, customer due diligence documents, identity records, and gold transaction files must be kept for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

  • Civil ID / KYC profile and due-diligence documents
  • Sales, invoices, and gold transaction history
  • Vault gold buyback and shop-floor AML compliance records

These records are for regulators, tax, and crime prevention — not for marketing.

4. WhatsApp and Meta

We stop sending app and WhatsApp marketing to a closed account. Data processed by Meta remains subject to Meta’s own retention.

5. Contact

Email is for questions only. Deletion is initiated in the app or on the website page above.
